verdict.rationale: Logseq's own documented controls let users decide where data is retained: sync is opt-in per graph, so some graphs can stay local only (logseq-docs-40). Pages are private unless explicitly marked `publish:: true` (logseq-docs-7). Users also note that data lives locally, under their control (logseq-comm-8, logseq-comm-20). However, nothing documents explicit deletion controls, retention settings, or purging of synced or published data. Missing for 10: documented deletion of synced server-side graphs, configurable retention policies, account/data deletion workflow, independent corroboration.
